_note: Verified 2026-07-12 from the live site stirlingx.io (home and /about), the GALLOS Technologies team page, press (TechRound, BusinessCloud, SiliconANGLE, all 2026-07-02), and Companies House 14111820. The entity was formerly GALLOS TECHNOLOGIES SUBSIDIARY 1 LIMITED, renamed StirlingX in 2025. Sir Jeremy Fleming is chairman, not a founder, and is deliberately excluded. Public facts only; no contact data.
one_liner: StirlingX runs a sovereign data intelligence platform that captures, secures, and fuses multi-sensor data into defence-grade insight for critical national infrastructure, defence, and government customers.
headcount_source: No public headcount. Estimate from the /about page (seven named operational leaders plus a chairman and advisors) and the Series A plan to grow the engineering team; treat as an estimate.

founders.name: Dean Jones
founders.background: Co-founder of GALLOS Technologies, the venture studio that incubated StirlingX; former Royal Marines with over two decades of operational experience; a Sloan Fellow at London Business School.

founders.name: Joshua Burch
founders.background: Co-founder of the parent studio GALLOS Technologies; former Head of Strategy and Risk at GCHQ and a partner at FTI Consulting who built its EMEIA cyber practice; appointed to the UK National Cyber Advisory Board in 2025.
